title: Replace public API not-implemented fallbacks

context.summary: Remove public API not-implemented fallback behavior from product routes.
context.background: The production API must either start with complete runtime dependencies or fail fast before serving traffic.

in: Replace route-level public not-implemented responses with startup dependency validation for product runtime.
Move dependency-free route factory coverage into explicit test fixtures.
Rename or remove skeleton-era API validation and documentation wording.
Update integration tests to prove production wiring serves real handlers.
Remove TASK-88-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Changing route semantics unrelated to missing runtime dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: Production API fails fast during startup when required runtime dependencies are missing.
Supported API routes no longer expose public 501 not_implemented responses.
Dependency-free route factory scenarios are isolated to tests and do not define product behavior.
Validation scripts no longer require skeleton or placeholder API behavior.

manual_checks: Confirm no supported API docs show 501 not_implemented as a normal response.
Confirm production server startup validates required dependencies.

risks: Tests that currently instantiate bare route factories must be updated without weakening production startup validation.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
